name: [ALPHA] Fleet Empire
desc:
This game is currently in ALPHA testing, minor bugs are to be expected.

Start with a cargo van and grow your transportation company from the ground up. Buy trucks, hire drivers, find freight, complete deliveries, and expand across the United States.

🚚 Build & manage your fleet
📦 Find freight & complete deliveries
👷 Hire & manage drivers
🤝 Build business relationships & unlock contracts
🏢 Team up with other companies
🔑 Rent trucks & grow your fleet
🏆 Compete on the leaderboards

Code: RELEASE & ALPHA 

[ALPHA TESTING | BUGS EXPECTED]
